world.title: ‘Bigger than internet’: Trump officially renames AI as ‘super intelligence’
world.summary: US President Donald Trump signed an executive order renaming "Artificial Intelligence" and "AI" to "super intelligence." This decision followed a high-level White House luncheon with prominent technology leaders, including Elon Musk, Mark Zuckerberg, Sundar Pichai, and Jensen Huang. The order aims to emphasize the significance of this technology, which Trump described as "bigger than the internet."

world.title: America.gov gets really weird when you ask it about Minecraft, but it's not a glitch
world.summary: The U.S. government launched an AI chatbot on America.gov, raising questions about its capabilities. Users noted unusual responses, particularly regarding Minecraft, leading to concerns about the chatbot's reliability. Engineers clarified that the tool is designed for national security and public interaction, emphasizing its purpose. The chatbot is not malfunctioning but operates within specific guidelines to ensure appropriate responses.

world.title: Pentagon Signs $20 Billion Boeing Deal For 6th-Generation Strike Fighter
world.summary: The Pentagon has awarded Boeing a $20 billion contract to develop the Navy's next-generation strike fighter, known as the F/A-XX aircraft. This decision was announced by US officials on Tuesday. The contract is part of the "Next Generation Air Dominance" program, aimed at enhancing the Navy's aerial capabilities with advanced technology and improved performance in future combat scenarios.

business.title: Stock Market Today: All You Need To Know Before Going Into Trade On Sept 30
business.summary: US stocks and bonds declined due to concerns over inflation and potential Federal Reserve rate hikes, despite a decrease in oil prices. Key brokerage calls and a complete trade setup are highlighted for investors ahead of trading on September 30. Market participants are advised to stay informed about these developments as they prepare for the trading day.

business.title: Apple Pay Now Available in India With Axis Bank Cards
business.summary: Apple Pay has launched in India, allowing customers with eligible Axis Bank cards to add them to the Wallet app on iPhone and Apple Watch. This enables users to make contactless and online payments. To utilize Apple Pay, users must possess an Axis Bank credit card. The service aims to enhance digital payment options for Indian consumers.

technology.title: Download Windows 11 26H2 ISO (offline installer) directly from Microsoft
technology.summary: Windows 11 26H2 ISO images are now available for download directly from Microsoft's portal. These images support x64 and Arm64 architectures and can be used for clean installations, upgrades, or creating bootable USB installers. This release represents Microsoft's annual feature update for 2026, with "26H2" indicating the second half of the year.

technology.title: Minecraft Dungeons II, Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve on Xbox X/S, PlayStation 5, Switch, PC: New Gameplay, graphics, characters for gamers on the way
technology.summary: New video games "Minecraft Dungeons II" and "Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve" are set to release this week for Xbox X/S, PlayStation 5, Switch, and PC. Both titles promise new gameplay, graphics, and characters, catering to a wide range of gamers. The releases are anticipated to enhance the gaming experience across multiple platforms.

technology.title: Henry Cavill’s next big role is game developer, and he’s doing it on a Googlebook
technology.summary: Google has announced a partnership with actor Henry Cavill, who will develop a video game using its new Googlebook laptops. This collaboration aims to showcase the capabilities of the Googlebook. Interested individuals can sign up for updates on the project. The initiative highlights Google’s recent launch of this new category of laptops designed for various creative tasks.

sports.title: Know India scores, updates and results from Day 11
sports.summary: On Day 11 of the Asian Games 2026, India is competing in wrestling, archery, and boxing. In women's compound team archery, India leads South Korea 118-115 at halftime, having initially trailed 30-29 after the first three arrows. The match saw India level the score at 59-59 before taking the lead, with updates on scores and medal winners ongoing.

sports.title: India's League of Legends team returns to Asian Games with Hangzhou lessons
sports.summary: Akshaj Shenoy, at 24, returns as captain of India's League of Legends team for the Asian Games 2026. The team, S8UL, aims to apply lessons learned from previous competitions. Shenoy's journey to professional gaming was unexpected, but he now leads the squad as they prepare to represent India in the upcoming event, showcasing their growth and experience.

sports.title: Asian Games 2026 LIVE: Indian women's compound team wins gold
sports.summary: India's women's compound archery team won gold at the Asian Games 2026 on September 30. The team, consisting of Jyothi Surekha Vennam, Prithika Pradeep, and Chikitha Tanwar, achieved this victory earlier in the day. Following this success, India is set to compete against Thailand in the compound mixed team semifinal, aiming for another gold medal in archery.

health.title: Scientists found that coffee changes gut microbes linked to mood and brain function; both caffeinated and decaf coffee were associated with lower stress, depression and impulsivity in a new study
health.summary: A study by APC Microbiome Ireland and University College Cork indicates that coffee, both caffeinated and decaffeinated, alters gut microbes linked to mood and brain function. The research suggests that coffee consumption is associated with reduced stress, depression, and impulsivity. These findings highlight the potential role of coffee in influencing mental health through changes in gut microbiota.

health.title: Cancer survivors are less likely to be physically active
health.summary: A new study published in AJPM Focus reveals that cancer survivors are less likely to engage in physical activity compared to individuals without a cancer history. Analyzing data from over 2 million US adults collected between 2018 and 2024, researchers emphasize the importance of regular physical activity for cancer survivors, highlighting a significant gap in their activity levels.

health.title: Heart disease in your 30s and 40s: Warning signs, tests and what doctors want you to know
health.summary: Heart problems can manifest before a major cardiac event, with symptoms like chest heaviness, breathlessness, and unusual fatigue often misinterpreted as acidity or stress. Three senior doctors outline risk factors for younger Indians, the importance of routine heart checks, how symptoms may differ in women, and recommended actions during a suspected heart attack. Awareness is crucial for prevention.

science.title: Dynamic instability of the Wilkes Subglacial Basin Ice Sheet, East Antarctica
science.summary: The Wilkes Subglacial Basin in East Antarctica holds enough ice to raise global sea levels by 3–4 meters. Its geometry may lead to unstable retreat, causing rapid sea level rise and disrupting ocean systems. Past evidence shows significant ice-sheet retreat during warm periods. Future projections indicate potential rapid retreat, necessitating multinational research to reduce uncertainties in climate impact assessments.

science.title: In Science, Endless Competing Models Are a Warning Sign
science.summary: Science is experiencing a stagnation in progress, marked by numerous competing theories without consensus, particularly regarding the origin of life. This proliferation of dead-end controversies suggests a lack of clarity and direction in scientific inquiry. As various hypotheses vie for acceptance, the absence of a unifying theory raises concerns about the current state and future trajectory of scientific research.

science.title: Why NASA is studying 1.2-billion-year-old Scottish rocks for clues to ancient life on Mars and the Red Planet’s watery past
science.summary: NASA is studying 1.2-billion-year-old rocks from Scotland's Stoer Formation to explore potential signs of ancient life. These underwater-formed rocks contain preserved evidence of microbial life. The research aids in interpreting findings from Mars, where NASA's Perseverance rover discovered a rock with mineral patterns suggesting biological origins. This study prepares for future sample analysis on the Red Planet.

entertainment.title: Taapsee Pannu’s idea of chaos? A Rs 2.3 lakh floral mini dress with zero fashion rules
entertainment.summary: Taapsee Pannu showcased her unique fashion sense by wearing a floral mini dress priced at Rs 2.3 lakh. Sharing images on Instagram, she captioned, “Let the chaos reign.” The dress combined playful femininity with a bold attitude, reflecting her signature style of being unorthodox and fashionably rebellious. Pannu's outfit emphasizes her preference for unpredictability in fashion choices.

entertainment.summary: Aquarius individuals are encouraged to exercise patience as positive developments unfold. The cosmos suggests extending compassion to oneself and others. Answers to long-held prayers are on the way, urging Aquarians to trust their instincts and inner voice.
